radioButton.description: Single radio select - clicks the option at given index

multiSelect.description: Multiple checkbox select - checks options at given indices

dropdown.description: Dropdown select - picks option at given index from each dropdown

fillInTheBlank.description: Types the value into the text input field

dragAndDrop.description: Drags each item to the drop zone in sequential order

orderedResponse.description: Keeps current order or reorders by index if specified

hotSpot.description: Clicks the hot spot area at given index on the image map

highlightTable.description: Clicks hot-text targets in the highlight table at given indices

highlightText.description: Clicks highlighted words in paragraphs at given indices

matrixMultipleChoice.description: Selects column at given index for each row in the matrix table

bowtie.description: Drags first N options into N targets for each column (A, B, C)

clozeDropdown.description: Drags options from labeled lists into inline cloze targets (triad pattern)

gapMatch.description: Clicks Move option button for each option in each list, picks the first menu item

matrixMultipleResponse.description: Table with checkbox groups per row - selects one checkbox per row at given index

multipleChoice.description: Native radio buttons (comp-multiplechoice) - clicks option at given index
